process_contaminants.contaminant: Glycidyl fatty acid esters (GE), expressed as glycidol
process_contaminants.finding: The highest levels of GE, as well as 3-MCPD and 2-MCPD (including esters) were found in palm oils and palm fats, followed by other oils and fats.
process_contaminants.limit_note: Maximum 1 000 μg/kg in vegetable oils and fats placed on the market for the final consumer or for use as an ingredient in food (Annex I, 5.4.1); 500 μg/kg in oils for baby food (5.4.2).
context_quotes: The substances form during food processing, in particular, when refining vegetable oils at high temperatures (approx. 200°C).
The Panel's review revealed that levels of GE in palm oils and fats halved between 2010 and 2015, due to voluntary measures taken by producers.

process_contaminants.contaminant: 3-MCPD and its fatty acid esters, expressed as 3-MCPD
process_contaminants.finding: The highest levels of GE, as well as 3-MCPD and 2-MCPD (including esters) were found in palm oils and palm fats, followed by other oils and fats.
process_contaminants.limit_note: Maximum 2 500 μg/kg in vegetable oils not named in Annex I 5.3.1.1, which include palm oil (5.3.1.2); the oils named there, such as sunflower and maize, have 1 250 μg/kg.
context_quotes: The substances form during food processing, in particular, when refining vegetable oils at high temperatures (approx. 200°C).
